GoMining is a Bitcoin cloud-mining platform that has grown into a full crypto ecosystem: Digital Miners, the GOMINING token, GoMining Card, Wallet, Simple Earn, the VIP programme and Miner Wars. We’re growing fast and plan to multiply sales next year. A large part of that growth will come from partners who already have big audiences.

This role brings those partners in. You’ll find and sign affiliates and partners with large networks in your region: crypto exchanges and media, iGaming operators and affiliate networks, brokers, fintech players, streamers and influencer agencies. Our offer to them is one of the strongest on the market: a high commission on every sale their audience makes, plus a lifetime revenue share. Your job is to put that offer in front of the right people and close the deal.

This is not a desk job and not mass cold outreach. You’ll spend much of your time in the field, at conferences, expos and meetings across your region, holding live negotiations every day. You’ll be one of the first members of a regional BD team we’re building from scratch. Your income grows directly with the volume your partners bring in, and the bonus is uncapped.

What you’ll do

Hunting: find the partners who matter

  • Map the partners with the biggest reach in your region: crypto (exchanges, wallets, media, communities), iGaming and gambling (operators, affiliate networks, streamers), brokers (forex, CFD, investment platforms), fintech and payments, large media and influencer agencies.
  • Work the field: attend crypto, iGaming, affiliate and fintech conferences across your region, book meetings in advance and close partnerships on site.
  • Use your own network and local reputation to get in front of decision-makers, not just whoever answers an email.

Closing: run the full cycle

  • Own every deal end to end: first contact, negotiation, agreeing terms, onboarding, launching traffic and the first sales.
  • Negotiate with founders and senior management, and show clearly what partnering with GoMining is worth to them and their audience.
  • When a partner says no, find out why and bring that back so we can sharpen the offer.

Growing: turn partners into volume

  • Grow the partners you’ve signed: higher volume, new formats, and special offers for their audiences.
  • Keep your pipeline up to date in the CRM, report weekly on the funnel, and file a short results report after every trip.
  • Share what you see in your market (competitor offers, partner expectations, local payment specifics) with the team.

What success looks like

First month: you know the product and the partner offer inside out, your regional pipeline is mapped, and your conference and meeting calendar for the next quarter is set.

First 3 months: you’re running a steady rhythm of in-person meetings, your first partnerships are signed and live, and the first sales are coming in through your partners.

Ongoing: we measure you on new active partners per month, sales volume and revenue from those partners, and how well your meetings convert into signed deals.

  • A track record of closing large partnership deals, with numbers you can walk us through.
  • Confidence negotiating with founders and senior management.
  • Readiness to travel a lot to conferences and meetings across your region.

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions.   • Extensive experience directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance

  • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space
  • Experience in or excitement in learning about financial technology infrastructure

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Job Title: Channel Partner Manager, Americas

Location: United States, Remote

The Business Development & Partnerships team plays an important role in our go-to-market strategy by building and scaling the ecosystem that surrounds Chainalysis, from technology alliances to system integrators and resellers. The team is responsible for identifying and developing inorganic growth opportunities, unlocking new routes to market, and fostering a diverse partner ecosystem that amplifies our reach while making it easier for customers to buy and deploy Chainalysis.

The Channel Partnerships Manager, Americas will own the day-to-day management of channel partners across the region, with a focus on activating, enabling, and growing a defined set of channel partners. This role is focused on regional execution and will be responsible for helping partners and internal field teams work together more effectively to drive pipeline, revenue, and market coverage in the Americas.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build strong working relationships with key partners in-region, including SI’s, consulting firms, resellers, distributors, and MSPs, and serve as the primary point of contact for partner engagement within the geo.

  • Drive partner enablement so partners can effectively position Chainalysis, qualify opportunities, navigate sales plays, and work within our channel processes and requirements.

  • Develop and execute joint plans with priority partners in AMER to increase partner-sourced pipeline, improve partner engagement, and expand partner contribution to regional growth.

  • Work closely with regional sales leaders, AEs, RevOps, Marketing, and Partnerships to align partners to the right accounts, opportunities, and go-to-market motions in-region.

  • Identify high-potential regional partners to prioritize, grow existing partner performance, and help recruit new partners where there is clear market opportunity or coverage need.

  • Support internal field enablement in AMER so sellers understand when and how to engage partners, the relevant program guidelines, and how to work effectively with indirect routes to market.

  • Run a consistent operating cadence with top partners, including business reviews, pipeline check-ins, account mapping, and escalation management where needed.

  • Track partner activity and outcomes in partnership with RevOps and sales, including partner-sourced pipeline, training progress, and overall partner performance in the region.

  • Coordinate closely with the broader Partnerships team to ensure regional execution is aligned to the overall program while remaining focused on in-market partner activation and revenue growth.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Proven experience managing channel, reseller, MSP, VAR, and SI relationships at a B2B technology or services company.

  • Demonstrated ability to enable partners effectively, including training on value proposition, sales plays, qualification, and how to work opportunities with internal sales teams.

  • Experience driving measurable business outcomes through partners, including partner-sourced pipeline

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with sales, marketing, RevOps, and other internal stakeholders to execute partner plans.

  • Strong commercial judgment and execution skills, including the ability to prioritize partners, manage competing opportunities, and navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience working in the US or in a multi-country region with different market dynamics, sales motions, and partner maturity levels.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility internally and externally.

  • Knowledge of the crypto and blockchain ecosystem and how it ties into the financial services industry, and the ability to ramp quickly on Chainalysis products, use cases, and customer needs in order to enable partners effectively.

  • Background in crypto, financial services, fintech, and/or compliance software.

Nice to have experience:

  • Experience at a consulting/services firm advising clients on digital asset initiatives

  • Experience with PRM tools, deal registration processes, account mapping, and partner performance tracking.

  • Experience building channels in an environment where direct sales and indirect routes to market must coexist and be carefully governed.

  • Comfort working across time zones and in a highly matrixed global organization.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI.

Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it.

You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done.

  • Lead product for our agentic compliance programme: AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start.

  • Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect.

  • Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways: Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why.

  • Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with.

  • Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences.

 
 

What this role is not

  • Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme.

  • Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention.

  • Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems.

 
 

Who we're looking for

  • 10+ years building software products, including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you.

  • A genuine zero-to-one track record: an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on.

  • Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company.

  • Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus.

  • AI-native: AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role.

  • Deep executional rigour: you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line.

  • High self-sufficiency: you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn.

  • Continuous systems thinking: you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster.

  • A data-informed operating style: you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees.

  • Judgement under ambiguity: you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist.

  • Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments: you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality.

  • Restlessness about velocity and quality: you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested.

If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hut 8 is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to operate and continuously improve the controls that protect the company’s technology environment. This role is hands-on and operations-oriented, with day-to-day responsibility across security tooling, identity, endpoint, network, cloud, vulnerability management, monitoring, and incident response.

The Cybersecurity Engineer is the day-to-day operator of the security capabilities designed and built by the Cybersecurity Architect. The role works closely with the Cybersecurity Architect, Technology Operations, Networking, Software, Data Engineering, Applied AI, Mining Operations, and external security partners to monitor, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve security operations.

This role reports to the Cybersecurity Partner, with close alignment to the Cybersecurity Architect and broader Technology organization.

What You'll Do

  • Operate, maintain, and improve security controls across corporate IT, cloud, SaaS, data center, mining, and AI/compute environments.
  • Configure, administer, and improve security technologies such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, identity and access management, firewalls, email security, cloud security, and security monitoring platforms.
  • Monitor security events, investigate alerts, support triage, and escalate potential incidents in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Support incident response activities, including evidence collection, containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident remediation.
  • Manage vulnerability scanning, asset coverage, prioritization, remediation tracking, exception handling, and validation of fixes.
  • Support identity and access controls, including MFA, SSO, joiner-mover-leaver workflows, privileged access, access reviews, service-account governance, and least-privilege improvements.
  • Implement and maintain endpoint, network, cloud, and application security configurations in partnership with technology owners.
  • Help secure APIs, integrations, CI/CD pipelines, production systems, and data platforms by applying approved security patterns and control requirements.
  • Develop and maintain security automation, scripts, integrations, dashboards, and workflows that improve coverage, consistency, and response time.
  • Participate in security architecture reviews, technical assessments, threat modeling, and control-validation exercises.
  • Maintain accurate security documentation, asset information, diagrams, runbooks, operating procedures, and technical records.
  • Support audit and compliance activities by gathering evidence, validating control operation, and helping remediate identified gaps.
  • Work with vendors and managed security providers to troubleshoot issues, validate service performance, and deliver agreed improvements.
  • Contribute to security testing, phishing exercises, configuration reviews, and other activities that improve organizational resilience.
  • Stay current on relevant threats, vulnerabilities, defensive techniques, and changes to the company’s technology environment

ABOUT YOU

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, systems administration, network engineering, cloud engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience with security monitoring, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, identity and access management, endpoint security, firewalls, or cloud security tools.
  • Working knowledge of networking, operating systems, authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, and common attack techniques.
  • Experience investigating security alerts or incidents and documenting findings, actions, and follow-up remediation.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with SaaS security and enterprise identity services.
  • Ability to automate routine work using scripting or programming languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and control environments, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, SOX ITGC, PCI, or comparable standards.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to prioritize work based on risk, business impact, and operational urgency.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GIAC, cloud security certifications, or vendor certifications are preferred.
  • Practical, curious, and collaborative, with a willingness to take ownership and improve processes rather than simply operate them.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
